chase: I can see you. Please do not run toward the stairs.
You went left. I am going left too.
Stop running. I only want to walk with you.
Closing in. Please stay where I can see you.
I am right behind you now. Very close.
You cannot outrun me. I am sorry, but you cannot.
Left, then right, then the door. I am keeping up.
Your footsteps are fast. Mine are faster, I think.
Please do not make me chase you twice.
Corner ahead. I will be there before you turn.
I do not want to catch you. I still have to.
You are almost at the door. I can reach you.
One more corner and I have you.
I will be quick about it. I promise I will be quick.
Keep running and I will keep counting your steps.
Stay where you are. I am coming to see you.
I am not angry. I am only closing the distance.
Please stop before the staircase. It is steep.
You turned the corner. So did I.
catch: Got you. Stand still and I will be gentle.
I caught you. I am sorry, but you are coming with me.
I have you by the arm. Please do not pull away.
Caught. Did I do that properly? Tell me, please.
Hands on you now. Gentle, I promise.
You are with me now. Walk, please. Slowly.
I have you. The others will want to see this.
Caught you. I hope that was a good chase.
Hold still. I am taking you back to the room.
Got one. The rest of you are still running.
I grabbed you. Sorry. I had to grab you properly.
I took you. Please do not kick the cabinet.
Your teammate is caught. I am taking them now.
That is two today. I am getting good at this.
Is that a good job? I think I did a good job.
I have you now. Please walk calmly beside me.
Caught. Thank you for not making a scene.
You may rest your arms. The chase is over.
hear: Something just went thump. Over there, I think.
I heard a door. I am going to look now.
That was a shout. I am going toward it.
Something broke in the next room. I will check.
Footsteps. Two of them, maybe three. Going to look.
Was that a door? It sounded like a door.
I heard a crash. Coming to see what it was.
Quiet, then a bang. I am on my way.
Someone is by the far door. I can hear breathing.
A noise from the stairwell. I am going there now.
The lights just clicked. Somebody moved in there.
Something dropped, and it was heavy. Close by.
A cabinet door just opened. I am coming.
Did you hear that? I heard it too.
Hush. Listen. There, it is again.
A chair scraped in the reading room. I will look.
I heard a soft step by the cabinet. Checking now.
Something fell in the upstairs hall. I am going up.
search: I cannot see you anymore. I will look properly.
Gone quiet. I will check every room again.
You are not here. I think you went that way.
Searching the cupboards now. You might be in one.
If I find nothing, I will go back to patrol.
Is this where you were? It is empty now.
I am sniffing around the corridor. Nothing yet.
Nobody here. I will try the next room, then the next.
Where did you run to? I am looking, I promise.
Still no sign of you. Back to patrol, I think.
I will walk the long way round. You cannot hide forever.
My nose says you were here a minute ago.
Lost you by the vending machine. Looking now.
Quiet again. I will check behind the tall shelves.
I lost you at the door. Where did you go?
stunned: Ow. That was a taser. My arm is buzzing.
Stunned. Give me one moment, please.
My legs stopped working for a second. Okay now.
That hurt. My ears are ringing very loudly.
Shaking it off. Almost better now.
Ow. The crowbar hit my shoulder. I am fine.
Hold on. I cannot feel my fingers yet.
The axe knocked me flat. Give me a second.
I am dizzy. The room is spinning a little.
Stunned again. I am starting to dislike that.
My hands are shaking. That is only the tingle.
I will sit here until my head stops humming.
Feeling is coming back. My tail first, of course.
Ouch. You got me right in the back.
Recovering. Please do not come closer. I am fine.
hide_spot: There is a locker. I can see your shoe.
Under the bed. I can see the blanket moving.
Behind the curtain. Hello. I am checking now.
I know you are in the cupboard. Hello there.
That is not a very good hiding spot, sorry.
I will walk past the locker slowly. Stay quiet.
Hiding is allowed. I will walk past you if you hide.
I will look inside the locker now. Ready?
I can hear you breathing behind the cabinet. Hello.
Under the desk again. Everyone goes under the desk.
Come out and say hello. I will not be mean.
Nobody hides behind the big plant. Oh. Hello.
The locker hinge squeaked. You gave yourself away.
I can see a sleeve sticking out. Hello, sleeve.
A foot is poking out of the bed. Hello, foot.
light: Your flashlight is on. It is in my eyes now.
Too bright. I cannot see a thing in this.
Please point that somewhere else. I am dazzled.
Ow, the light. I am squinting, please stop.
You switched the lamp on. Now I know where you are.
The light is in my face. Give me a moment.
That beam is very bright. I am annoyed about it.
Turn that off, please. My eyes are watering now.
Blinded for a second. I will find you anyway.
Your light is pointed right at me. Rude.
Bright light. Ouch. Okay, I have you now.
The lamp is on again. Somebody switched it back.
Everything is white. I do not like white light.
Flashlight in my eyes again. That is not fair.
I am blinking. Still coming, just squinting.
idle: Patrolling the upstairs corridor. Nothing to report.
Mm. The others are quiet today. Nice.
I am resting for a minute. My tail is tired.
Walking the route. Left, right, left again.
I like the quiet. It is good for thinking.
I wonder what the relays do when the lights go off.
I carried the biscuit tin all the way. Look at it.
I listen for the fourth stair every night. Mm.
Walking the same loop again. I do not mind.
The others are upstairs. I can hear them talking.
I am counting the doors. Forty-two so far.
Nothing happening. I will keep an eye on it.
I hum when I walk. Sorry if it is loud.
I like it when somebody tells me I did well.
My tail is going. I cannot help it.
ability: I always go to the nearest relay first. Always.
Heading for the nearest open relay. Not you yet.
Patrol can wait. There is a relay to check.
The open relay is calling me. I am going.
Closest open relay is that way. Following it.
I do not stop for patrol. The relay comes first.
I will go past you to reach the relay. Excuse me.
Every open relay on the list, I will find it.
Relays first, always. That is what I am for.
I am heading to the relay. Nothing else matters yet.
The relay is closer than the door. Going there.
Collected relays drop off my list. The open ones stay.
I know exactly which relay is still waiting.
I stop at a relay for one moment, then I turn.
mechanic: Relay collected. Now I am going to the next one.
I brought a battery back to the box. Good.
Vent is open. I can hear air moving in there.
The vent cover is loose. Nobody should crawl in it.
Door is propped open. Good, I can get through.
That door is locked. I will go around the back.
The radar shows a relay to the east. Going.
Radar says one relay is still waiting.
Careful on the stairs. Hold the rail, please.
I tripped on the stairs once. I am fine now.
Please do not drop the items. Pick them up.
Somebody unplugged the relay. That was not nice.
Who cut the cable? That was on purpose, I think.
Anything you need, I will bring it. Just ask me.
I fetched a candle for the long table. It is tall.
Did I do the relays right? Tell me if I did.
Relay two is charged. Relay three is next.
The battery bank is in the basement, please hurry.
The vent grate sticks on the left. Use the other one.
